title: General.
officialText:
Concrete shall be mixed until there is a uniform distribution of materials and shall be discharged completely
before the mixer is recharged. Concrete delivered shall be proportioned in accordance with Section 1905.2.3. Modification to
the approved concrete proportions shall be based upon standards acceptable to the commissioner.
